title.en: Chapter 1 — The King Who Would Not Say His Name
title.ar: الفصل 1 — الملك اللي ما بده يقول اسمه

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: كنت قاعد عند هولمز بشارع بيكر لما دق الجرس.
sentences.en: I was sitting with Holmes on Baker Street when the bell rang.
A client, wealthy, and wanting to hide his name.

sentences.ar: سألته: من وين عرفت كل هاد؟
sentences.en: I asked him: how did you know all that?

sentences.ar: قال: ورق المكتوب اللي وصلني غالي.
sentences.en: He said: the paper of the letter that reached me is costly.
And the hand is not English.

sentences.ar: واللي بده يخبي اسمه بيكتب مكتوب قبل ما يجي.
sentences.en: And a man who wants to hide his name writes a letter before he comes.

sentences.ar: فات رجل طويل ولابس قناع على نص وجهه.
sentences.en: A tall man came in wearing a mask over half his face.

sentences.ar: قال: بتقدروا تنادوني الكونت فون كرام.
sentences.en: He said: you may call me Count von Kramm.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز بهدوء: أهلاً فيك يا صاحب الجلالة.
sentences.en: Holmes said calmly: welcome, Your Majesty.
